defect_class: CITATION RESOLVES AND IDENTIFIES THE RIGHT PAPER, BUT THE PAPER DOES NOT SUPPORT THE CLAIM
note_on_this_file: Consolidated record. The repair was applied in three passes during development, so the script's own last-run output records only the final pass. This file is the full inventory. Re-running repair_cost_provenance_20260829.py on a fresh checkout applies all 47 sites in one pass and is a no-op here.

wrong_source.actual: Hernandez I, Prasad V, Gellad WF. Total Costs of Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-Cell Immunotherapy. JAMA Oncol. 2018;4(7):994-996.
wrong_source.was_cited_as: generic drug pricing database / systematic review of global generic drug pricing
wrong_source.correct_use_elsewhere: build_cart_access.py cites the same PMID correctly, in a CAR-T access context
wrong_source.why_gates_missed_it: Every identifier is correct - PMID resolves, author Hernandez, year 2018, title agrees with PubMed - so PMID validation, title agreement, coordinate checking and the retraction gate are all silent by construction. audit_prose_citation_titles.py DID see it at line 41 and filed it under journal_not_recognised, a gate-artifact bucket, because the citation string names no journal for the gate to compare.

sites_repaired.what: methodology paragraph (invented description of the cited paper)

lesson: A wrong source spreads by paraphrase. Two passes reported success while the same claim survived in differently-worded captions ('WHO generic drug databases' vs 'WHO pricing databases'). Only grep for the bare identifier cleared it.
provenance_after_repair: NONE - figures retained unchanged and marked unsourced; no substitute source was invented

unrelated_citation_removed.was_cited_as: glyburide widely studied in gestational diabetes

preclinical_overstatement_repaired.paper: Lamkanfi et al. Glyburide inhibits the Cryopyrin/Nalp3 inflammasome. J Cell Biol 2009.
preclinical_overstatement_repaired.removed_claim: demonstrated direct NLRP3 inhibition at concentrations achievable in vivo
preclinical_overstatement_repaired.why: in vitro mouse macrophage and human monocyte work plus one mouse LPS-lethality experiment; the abstract states no in vivo achievable concentration and no human received glyburide for an inflammatory outcome
